metadata.case_name: SO CHUNG KWONG v. NG MING FONG

plaintiff.occupation_after: Painter or similar (also worked as watchman/cleaner intermittently)

injuries.description: broken the scaphoid bone in his left hand
source: he was examined and found to have broken the scaphoid bone in his left hand as well as suffering minor abrasions.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of scaphoid bone of hand

injuries.description: injury to his left wrist resulted in residual pain and lack of mobility
source: But pain and lack of mobility persisted in his left wrist, right palm and right ankle, and he was given sick leave until March 1991.
There is still a residual pain in his left wrist, now 11 years later, and it is not as flexible as it was before the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand, unspecified

injuries.description: injury to his left wrist and right hand resulted in a permanently reduced strength in grip and pinch
source: She found that the injury to his left wrist and right hand resulted in a permanently reduced strength in grip and pinch, which would limit his ability to perform as a carpenter because of reduced strength and endurance.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand, unspecified
